title: Micro reorg impact — quick table and handback asks
content:
Purpose: quick one-off sheet to estimate the near-term operational impact of the small reorg pilot (shifting 2 full-time SREs from infra to platform feature support for 8 weeks). Not final — use to coordinate handbacks and short-term hires/overrides.

Notes / context (short)::
- Trigger: product asked for dedicated support for a new Dedicated tier rollout; SRE team offered temporary reassignments for first 8 weeks to reduce time-to-ship.
- Goal: capture which owners are exposed, what tasks will slip, and minimal compensating actions (contractors, on-call swaps, deprioritization).
- Keep it lightweight; we want a single-page source for stakeholders (product, infra, SRE, ENG ops).

Quick table (rows = impact buckets). Columns: owner | area | est hours/week impact | critical? (Y/N) | predicted slip (wks) | blocker | suggested short fix | handback owner
---
SRE Team (A) | infra capacity / incidents | 14 | Y | 1-3 | nightly job backlog | temporary runbook & weekly clean-up sprint (2 ppl x 4h) | Daniel Kim
Platform SDKs | release cadence / feature triage | 10 | Y | 2 | missing test-run infra | pair with infra SME + gated canary | Ravi Desai
Observability | dashboards + alerts tuning | 8 | N | 3-4 | lower fidelity on new routes | reduce retention window for non-prod; narrow alert scope | Lena García
Billing & Cost | cost ops tagging & recon | 6 | N | 2 | delayed cost tagging | surface pri tags only; manual reconcile at EOW | Aisha Patel
Oncall rotations | escalation bandwidth | 12 | Y | 1-2 | oncall fatigue | short-term oncall swap + override budget for OT | SRE-rotation-leads
Customer escalations | SE triage for pilot customers | 7 | Y | 0-1 | SE bandwidth | escalate to cross-functional concierge; product field resources | Product-eng lead

Quick calculations (back-of-envelopes)::
- Total estimated hours/week shifted: 57 hrs/wk (~1.4 FTE equivalent assuming 40hr wk split across owners).
- Cost of temporary contractors: estimate $90/hr * 57 * 8 weeks ≈ $41k (rough).
- If we accept 2-week delay on non-critical items (observability), unblocked critical rollout path preserved.

Open questions / risks::
- Which incidents are considered "critical" vs acceptable to defer? (need product signoff)
- If we hit a P1 during weeks 3–6, do we pause the pilot? decision owner: SRE director.
- Are there existing contractors with infra experience we can onboard quickly (2 week ramp)? list in linked artifacts.

Suggested immediate asks (today -> 72h)::
1) Product: confirm list of pilot customers and acceptable incident tolerance window (owner: Product-eng lead) — due 2026-08-21.
2) SRE: nominate 1 single point-of-contact per impacted sub-area (infra, oncall, observability) and confirm ability to accept OT budget if needed — due 2026-08-20.
3) Finance: pre-approve up to $50k one-time contractor/OT fund for the 8-week pilot — due 2026-08-22.
4) Eng ops: prepare a lightweight runbook template for temporary oncall swaps and cross-training checklist — due 2026-08-23.

Quick handback plan (post 8 weeks)::
- Week -1 before handback: schedule knowledge transfer sessions (2 x 90m) led by temp cover -> permanent owners.
- Week 0: feature traffic ramp down for pilot support; freeze additional scope.
- Week 1–2: measured reinstatement of original rosters; keep 4-week monitoring window.

Recent updates / edits:
- 2026-08-21: added cost estimate and initial product ask (Lena).
- 2026-08-25: SRE nominated Daniel as infra POC — updated on table.
- 2026-09-02: Finance tentatively approved OT fund (notes attached in linked artifacts).

To do / next steps (triage list)::
- [ ] Get product tolerance matrix (P0/P1/P2 definitions per customer) — owner: Product-eng lead.
- [ ] Confirm contractor short-list and hourly rates — owner: Eng ops.
- [ ] Build simple dashboard to surface tickets by owner (one-pan view) — owner: Observability (quick spike).
- [ ] Publish this sheet to cross-functional slack channel and request approvals on the four asks above.

Notes to self: keep this one-pager short; stakeholders will prefer a one-sentence summary + table. If more detail needed, link to Confluence micro-reorg proposal.

Attachments / raw links (also in linked_artifacts):
- Jira: JIRA-7213 (pilot-run ticket)
- Confluence: platform/micro-reorg-proposal (detailed rationale + risk register)
- Github PR: infra/ops-config#456 (temp oncall routing change)

End of quick table.
